digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, file-impact scoping, attestation manifest
propositions: file_impact field is overloaded: empty state means both undeclared and genuinely no files changed, causing inappropriate whole-HEAD invalidation for legitimate no-file-impact tickets
containers with any undeclared child apply poison rule that collapses entire inherited drift scope to empty, invalidating path declarations of siblings

attestation validity requires explicit tri-state declaration (undeclared/paths/none) so that declared-none tickets remain valid across unrelated commits while undeclared tickets conservatively re-validate on any commit
declared-none children must not poison container inheritance; container rollup should union only path-declaring children and treat declared-none children as neutral
LLM-judged plan-review criterion fires deterministically on presence of no-file-impact assertion to verify the claim is truthful for the plan
